caption: The drawing features three main objects on a plain, light beige background. At the top center is an open parasol with a light, almost translucent fabric canopy in shades of white and light gray, and a wooden handle in a natural tan color with visible grip texture. The parasol is drawn in a realistic style, with shading that depicts the folds and contours of the fabric. Directly beneath the parasol, there are two triangular, lace-like designs positioned side by side. Both lace designs are black, highly detailed, and symmetrical, with intricate floral and swirling patterns. The lace on the left has denser, more elaborate patterns with many tight spirals and leaf motifs, while the lace on the right features a more open composition with more pronounced floral forms and more negative space. All three objects are vertically aligned and centered on the page, with the parasol above and the two lace designs below, equidistant from each other. The drawing is executed in ink and watercolor, with fine line work and minimal color besides the shades used for the parasol.
title: Parasol
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
